verdict.rationale: Raygun's docs mention sending dSYMs and uploading ProGuard mapping files, which implies iOS and Android crash symbolication. They also say each error captures OS, device, version and full stack traces, giving the context needed to reproduce crashes. However, native mobile SDKs are only inferred from these symbol-upload services rather than documented directly, and NDK is never mentioned. Missing for 10: explicit iOS/Android SDK documentation, any NDK/native C/C++ crash support, app-version and device capture shown specifically for mobile, and independent or hands-on corroboration of mobile crash capture.
